response.final_analysis: Chloroquine is established in treating Discoid Lupus Erythematosus due to its anti-inflammatory and immunomodulatory effects. It is also used in Rheumatoid Arthritis but not typically recommended for Infectious Mononucleosis, which is not effectively treated by chloroquine. Therefore, the most accurate options are those related to its use in autoimmune diseases.
